Avoid stale load overwriting latest named buffer: cache decoded bytes by assetId+digest/generation or enforce generation within compatible load adapter, not only a then() playback check. Preserve post-decode live() and source.onended identity checks.

Preserve RMS/gain instrumentation and context-close error reporting; do not replace with historical port that allows decoded buffer insertion after disposal.

patchInstructions: Three APIs are not interchangeable. Keep main factory callable shape and AudioContextLike/AudioNodeLike exports; keep modern snapshot createAudioPlaybackRuntime and its strict decoder. Introduce reviewed overload/adapter for historical object input, AudioPlaybackPort/types and setMasterVolume alias if that branch public API is accepted. Never erase either modern API with an old snapshot.

Adapter must deny Kids before context construction; preserve existing main error compatibility or explicitly version/refusal-map it. Keep await-compatible play and deterministic stop/replacement/dispose.

Do not turn strict WAV runtime into an unbounded ambient browser decoder. Main descriptor pipeline also advertises OGG/MP3; choose explicit contained codec adapter or named unsupported-format policy with backward-compatibility acceptance, not silently pretend PCM supports all three.
Preserve SDK source inventory plus public declaration/import closure for both port/runtime and any adapter. Missing snapshot tree files are not intentional deletions.

Snapshot already has packages/engine-presentation/test/audio-playback.test.ts with FOUR strict-runtime tests. Union the two historical port tests with these four; main absence of this file is not permission to discard snapshot tests.

Historical and main AudioContextLike exports have different structural contracts under the same name. Do not duplicate or silently widen that public name; an overload with explicit legacy context adapter/types or versioned compatibility namespace needs public-consumer type fixtures. Preserve modern factory and runtime interfaces unchanged.
acceptance: Restore/adapt two audio-playback tests and seam factory export assertion; direct API imports must typecheck under historical, main and snapshot consumer shapes.
Retain modern strict RIFF envelope, PCM channels/rates/duration/byte limit, source cap, user gesture, hidden stop, unlock-dispose race and transactional node cleanup tests.
Explicit compatibility test matrix: WAV accepted; OGG/MP3 codec/refusal contract; Kids zero constructor/decode/network calls; wrong digest no decode; main RMS feature retained.
Public test source set: db8afa68 audio-playback.test.ts:5,31 + seam:26 + delayed Stop golden:3915; 346933c runtime tests:30,41,92,104; retain all as distinct assertions.
